description: This file defines a Paypal class for handling PayPal API interactions, including order creation, capture, webhook management, and webhook verification, with database updates via Prisma.

classes.name: Paypal
classes.description: A class encapsulating PayPal API interactions, including order management, webhook handling, and token management.

methods.name: getAccessToken
methods.description: Fetches and caches the PayPal access token.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new PayPal order with specified details.

methods.name: captureOrder
methods.description: Captures a PayPal order and updates related payment and booking records.

methods.name: createWebhook
methods.description: Creates a PayPal webhook for order events.

methods.name: listWebhooks
methods.description: Lists existing PayPal webhooks filtered by URL.

methods.name: verifyWebhook
methods.description: Verifies a webhook signature with PayPal.
